comment: Thresholds of `jjv qa preflight`: every check that needs NO rendered pixels. The pacing floors (logo still, card length) and the icon thresholds are NOT repeated here: they come from review-gates-v001 (one number, one place; a config qa.review block may only tighten them). Only what the review recipe has no key for lives below. same_framing_ncc_min_source is calibrated on six ep04 boundaries measured on SOURCE clip frames: user-rejected same-seat flashes 0.54 and 0.33, accepted layout changes 0.135 / 0.122 / 0.045 / 0.018 (the rendered-frame threshold of Q3 is 0.35; the render adds identical captions to both sides, which raises its NCC, so the source threshold is lower).

transitions.native_frame_policy: outgoing = frame before the window, incoming = first frame after it, both mapped to the SOURCE clip by native_frames / delivery_frames
